purpose: Deterministic resolver contract for the authLogin/authRefresh response layer using authoritative RoleAssignment data.

input.accountState: Authoritative account state evaluated before successful token issuance/rotation.
input.roleAssignments: All RoleAssignment records for subjectId that can be read from the D1-01 authorization authority.

algorithm.name: account-state-gate
algorithm.rule: If accountState is not ACTIVE, return DENY under the existing authentication/error contract; do not resolve a successful layer.

algorithm.name: subject-filter
algorithm.rule: Retain only assignments whose subjectId exactly equals the authenticated subjectId.

algorithm.name: status-filter
algorithm.rule: Retain only assignments with status ACTIVE.

algorithm.name: time-filter
algorithm.rule: Retain only assignments where validFrom <= now and (validUntil is null or now < validUntil).

algorithm.name: scope-filter-for-global-layer
algorithm.rule: Retain only assignments with scopeType=global for the public response layer. organization and ip assignments are excluded from global layer resolution.

algorithm.name: role-validation
algorithm.rule: Every retained roleId MUST exist exactly once in contracts/authz/layers.json. Unknown or forbidden role identifiers cause fail-closed resolution.

algorithm.name: layer-mapping
algorithm.rule: Map each retained roleId directly to its declared L0-L8 layer in contracts/authz/layers.json. No alternate projection may override this mapping.

algorithm.name: multiple-assignment-resolution
algorithm.rule: When more than one eligible global assignment exists, select the highest numeric layer value. Multiple assignments resolving to the same layer are equivalent; no secondary precedence is required.

algorithm.name: no-assignment-failure
algorithm.rule: If no eligible global assignment remains, do not infer a layer from User.role, Verification, Entitlement, Subscription, Organization Membership, Ownership, device, IP, cache, or any other uncontracted signal. Return DENY under the existing authentication/error contract.

algorithm.name: derived-output
algorithm.rule: Return the selected layer only as a derived response value. Do not persist it as User.layer or another layer entity.

securityInvariants: RoleAssignment is authorization input, not the final authorization decision.
Layer is derived capability level and cannot bypass scope, ownership, entitlement, workflow, business-state or policy checks.
Cache is never the source of truth.
RoleAssignment revocation or effective-set change participates in role_version invalidation.
Client-provided request data cannot establish or elevate a RoleAssignment.

implementationBoundary.allowed: Implement only the deterministic algorithm above at an existing W01/Payload extension point after the E6 implementation-admission gate is GREEN.
forbidden: hand-authored persistence schema inferred from resolver needs

verificationRequirements: global user role resolves to expected layer
organization/IP scoped role does not alter global login/refresh layer
multiple global roles select highest numeric layer
non-ACTIVE account state fails before successful token response
no eligible global assignment fails closed
cache state cannot alter the result
